name: Blue Ribbon Pig Piece
desc: A crystal piece that resembles Blue Ribbon Pig. When used, the crystal will melt into the body, and its mythical power will transform the user into Blue Ribbon Pig. This mythical power will last for an hour.

name: Tigun Transformation Bundle.
desc: A secret medicine that allows you to transform into Tigun, the patrol guard.

name: Rainbow-colored Snail Shell
desc: A special shell only found through Mano. Apparently it's powerful enough to grant a wish...

name: Change to Ghost
desc: First the body feels light, then all of a sudden, you're floating. Oh no, you're a ghost!

name: Ghost Candy
desc: A ghost-shaped candy with a mysterious set of ingredients. Apparently it has some special powers.

name: Sophillia's Abandoned Doll
desc: An abandoned doll that Sophillia threw away a long time ago, but revived by the Masked Man. Pet its hair, and you'll turn into Sophillia for 3 minutes.

name: Potion of Transformation
desc: The moment this potion is taken, you'll become a powerful, otherworldly being.

name: Potion of Transformation
desc: The moment this potion is taken, you'll become a powerful, otherworldly being.

name: Change to Mouse
desc: Transform into a small, tiny mouse.

name: Mini Draco Transformation
desc: The mysterious skills of an old halfling has transformed you into a form of a dragon. You can now fly.

name: Moon Photo
desc: The more you look at it, the more you feel lightheaded… and you feel closer to the moon.

name: Sweet Rice Cake
desc: A sweet, delicious rice cake. Sometimes creates an interesting set of powers.

name: Gaga Transformation Potion
desc: The moment you drink this potion, you'll become the biggest star in the world of Maple, Gaga.

name: Peto Transformation Potion
desc: A transformation potion from the masked gentleman that allows you to transform into Peto for 15 minutes.

name: Geppetto Transformation
desc: You've entered a fable and transformed into Geppetto. You’re feel a bit sluggish, but do your best to leave the dungeon with your party members.

name: Cody's Picture
desc: A picture given by Cody of himself.  I get a feeling something fun will happen when I use it.

name: Cake Picture
desc: A picture of a delicious cake that Cody gave as a gift.  I get a feeling something funny with happen when I use it.

name: Alien Gray Transformation
desc: The mysterious force emanating from the crystal statue shall be absorbed into your body, and you will no longer find yourself as you are.

name: Penguin Transformation 1
desc: Will transform you into a penguin.

name: Penguin Transformation 2
desc: Will transform you into a penguin.

name: Penguin Transformation 3
desc: Will transform you into a penguin.

name: Penguin Transformation 4
desc: Will transform you into a penguin.

name: Penguin Transformation 5
desc: Will transform you into a penguin.

name: Leech Costume
desc: An offensive-looking leech costume. Can be worn to trick your friends.

name: Cliff's Special Potion
desc: No one knows what you'll transform into when you drink this, but something WILL happen for one hour.  It's all about the risk...

name: Maplemas Party Potion
desc: Double-click on this to transform a character of your choice. Which one? Try it and find out!

desc: You are now Diddy Kong!

name: Moonstone Engagement Ring Box
desc: Engagement Ring made of Moon Rock. The ring will be inside a wrapped box. Required for proposal.

name: Star gem Engagement Ring Box
desc: Engagement Ring made of Star Rock. The ring will be inside a wrapped box. Required for proposal.

name: Golden Heart Engagement Ring Box
desc: Engagement Ring made of gold. The ring will be inside a wrapped box. Required for proposal.

name: Silver Swan Engagement Ring Box
desc: Engagement Ring made of silver. The ring will be inside a wrapped box. Required for proposal.

name: Revitalizer
desc: Restores tamed monster's fatigue level by 30.

name: Pheromone Perfume
desc: A perfume created by Kenta using Pheromone. Enables the user to tame hogs down at the Korean Folk Village.

name: Pouch
desc: A pouch with a jewel on the surface. Possesses a special power in that double-clicking the pouch will suck up the surrounding ghosts in the area.

name: Element Rock
desc: A special alchemist tool that converts an absorbed power of monster into a jewel. The inner part seems to be slightly transparent.

name: Cliff's Magic Cane
desc: A magic cane that tames the lost Rudolph.

name: 1st Transparent Marble
desc: A special magic marble that can contain a poisoned monster on the 1st floor.

name: 2nd Transparent Marble
desc: A special magic marble that can contain a poisoned monster on the 2nd floor.

name: 3rd Transparent Marble
desc: A special magic marble that can contain a poisoned monster on the 3rd floor.

name: Purification Marble
desc: It's a special magic marble that can contain and purify a monster.

name: Fish Net
desc: A fish net intended to catch something. Can be used with Gaga.

stats.delayMsg: You cannot use the Fishing Net yet.

name: Red Ribbon Pig
desc: A red ribbon that helps catch Maze Pig.

name: Green Ribbon Pig
desc: A green ribbon that helps catch Maze Pig.

desc: A blue ribbon that helps catch Maze Pig.

name: Purple Ribbon Pig
desc: A purple ribbon that helps catch Maze Pig.

name: Rope
desc: A sturdy rope used for catching a Mutant Ribbon Pig. Double-click to use.

name: Lava Bottle
desc: A glass bottle that contains an actual lava, which is waiting to be spilled out. Drink this lava, and the lava will consume the body with fire, which will enable the drinker to master Fire Demon.

name: Black Cloud Machine
desc: A mechanical device that produces black clouds. Enables the character to acquire the Smokescreen skill using the clouds.

name: Firm Hand
desc: A stimulant packaged inside a bottle that resembles a clenched fist. Drinking the stimulant will allow the character to acquire The Will of a Warrior.

name: Tulip
desc: A lovely yellow bloom easily found scattered throughout the plains.

name: Rose
desc: A pretty pink flower easily found scattered throughout the plains.

name: Lily Blossom
desc: An elegant yellow bloom easily found scattered throughout the forest.

name: Lily Leaf
desc: The long, narrow leaf of a lily, easily found scattered throughout the forest.

name: Strobilanthes Oligantha Bloom
desc: The shape of this lovely flower is reminiscent of a bell. It can be  easily found scattered throughout forests and near water.

name: Strobilanthes Oligantha Leaf
desc: A rather ordinary-looking leaf, easily found scattered throughout forests and near water.

name: Moss Ball
desc: A round clump of green algae that looks soft but has surprisingly little give when you poke it. It's often found floating in rivers, soaking up the sun.

name: Crassula Blossom
desc: The white flower of a crassula plant. These plants are usually found in rocky areas or mountain meadows.

name: Crassula Leaf
desc: The thick, succulent leaf of a crassula plant. \r\nThese plants are known for their ability to purify the air.

name: Broccoli
desc: The head of the plant looks like dark green flowers. They're found under rocks in the plains. \r\nContains a ton of vitamins.

name: Poison Mushroom
desc: These red-capped mushrooms grow under rocks. Dry them and then boil them to make their toxins into a usable poison.

name: Horny Mushroom
desc: A mushroom with what almost appear to be deer antlers on them. They're found near trees.

name: Allium
desc: Round, and almost ball-like. Look a little closer, and you'll see these flowers have a cotton candy-like softness.

name: Titan Arum
desc: These lively blooms are famous throughout Maple World. They look warm but smell like rotting flesh.

name: Monkey Orchid
desc: These curious flowers look like miniature Lupins from Ellinia! They grow on top of trees, just like monkeys!

name: Pink Bean Leaf
desc: The leaf of a pink bean plant. The beans from this plant looks like Pink Bean.

name: Pink Bean Fruit
desc: A fruit that looks like Pink Bean, a creature form another world. Stir fry it to make it sweet.

name: Sarracenia
desc: These plants are known to produce sweet scents that attract insects. Touch it gently and you just might free a bug that was trapped inside!

name: Bellflower Fruit
desc: The reddish fruit that grows on a Bellflower. It kind of looks like ginseng.

name: Bellflower Root
desc: The memorable bitter taste of this root might actually be very, very good for your health!

name: Bee Bee Tree Fruit
desc: The bee bee tree looks like like the monster Rash from Leafre. Its fruit kind of looks like a chestnut.

name: Bee Bee Tree Leaf
desc: The bee bee tree looks like like the monster Rash from Leafre. It's leaves don't seem very useful.

name: Carrot Slime Leaf
desc: Carrot Slimes are usually found near water. Their leaves are edible but not very tasty.

name: Carrot Slime Root
desc: These roots are round and soft. They're supposed to be amazing for your skin.

name: Flower Fish Bloom
desc: Looks sort of like the bloom atop the Flower Fish at Aqua Road. Not much to write home about, to be honest.

name: Flower Fish Leaf
desc: Looks sort of like the fins of the Flower Fish at Aqua Road. Can be stir-fried and eaten, but be warned, it's quite fishy.

name: Borometz Fruit
desc: This fruit looks soft, warm, and cozy. Can be used like a sort of cotton.

name: Borometz Leaf
desc: Found in rocky areas. Dry them out and make tea! It'll taste like soup.

name: Musella Leaf
desc: These large leaves are perfect for shading you from the sun.

name: Musella Fruit
desc: This brightly colored fruit is like a golden lotus banana! Right?

name: Lotus Blossom
desc: Just looking upon this beautiful blossom seems to purify your spirit and uplift your soul.

name: Lotus Leaf
desc: These wide, green leaves have a pleasant scent. Perfect to be used for cooking or to drink as tea.

name: Purple Flower Blossom
desc: Round, shiny, and very expensive-looking!

name: Purple Flower Leaf
desc: Wide and rather stiff.

name: Skeleton Flower
desc: The petals of this delicate bloom turn transparent when they get wet!

name: Sunflower Blossom
desc: These large, cheery flowers adore the sunshine.

name: Sunflower Leaf
desc: Sunflower leaves aren't really very useful.

name: Horn Flower
desc: This flower grows on the horns of an Alpine Goat. A valuable specimen for the ongoing research taking place at Spring Valley.

name: Strobilanthes Oligantha
desc: Alpine Birds love to adorn themselves with this pretty bloom. A valuable specimen for the ongoing research taking place at Spring Valley.

name: Red Fruit
desc: The otters of Spring Valley love this fruit. A valuable specimen for the ongoing research taking place at Spring Valley.

name: Pollen
desc: Extracted from the wings of a Spring Valley butterfly. A valuable specimen for the ongoing research taking place at Spring Valley.
